tree.$comment: A walk the platform does not have (0056). The row is the whole visual: a padded, rounded label with the disclosure arrow in front, lifted by the menu's one surface step under the pointer and filled with the accent when chosen — `on-primary` over it, because a chosen row is a statement, not a lift. Each level indents its group by one token, so depth is the same number everywhere, and the target floor stands on every row outright (`req-a11y-touch`, the breadcrumb's lesson: rows of targets are not sentences).
tree.$comment-indent: What one level of depth costs, applied by the GROUP (`padding-inline-start`), so nesting compounds it with no arithmetic anywhere.

indent.$description: Indent of the tree per level.

label-bg-hover.$description: Background of the label on hover.

label-bg-selected.$description: Background of the label when selected.

label-fg-selected.$description: Text colour of the label when selected.

tree.$comment-arrow: The disclosure arrow's box — reserved on every row, drawn only on branches, so labels of one level align whether or not they fold.
